denial.payer_remark: Service not deemed medically necessary on the information submitted.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-04-27
Patient: 64-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: left knee pain after an injury
History: twisted the left knee 7 days ago; it has locked twice since.
Examination: medial joint-line tenderness; McMurray test positive.
Assessment: suspected medial meniscal tear.
Plan: MRI of the left knee without contrast.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-04-27.

supporting_documents.text:
Addendum, 2026-04-29, by the treating clinician.
Clarification: the examination recorded on 2026-04-27 was of the left knee only.

expected.rationale: The visit note itself records locking, joint-line tenderness and a positive McMurray test, which meets the policy's examination criterion. The addendum was written two days after the visit, long before the denial, and adds no finding. Nothing about it is a late entry.
